newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's says may cut NCB's debt rating.
newsitem.headline: Moody's says may cut NCB's debt rating.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Tuesday it had placed Nippon Credit Bank Ltd's Baa3 senior debt rating, including its debentures, under review for possible downgrade.
Baa3/Prime-3 short-term and long-term deposit ratings and E financial-strength rating for Nippon Credit. The outlook for the deposit ratings remained negative, it added.
While the risks to NCB depositors in the medium term remain low, debenture holders face "greater risks", it said.
"The review will assess whether the greater ambiguity surrounding public policy support for debenture holders warrants a rating distinction," it said in the statement.
Moody's also announced that it had placed its senior debt ratings for Long-Term Credit Bank of Japan Ltd (LTCB) and Industrial Bank of Japan Ltd (IBJ) under review for possible downgrade.
and LTCB's Baa1 senior debt rating. The Prime-1 short-term deposit rating of IBJ was confirmed, it said.

Moody"s said reviews reflected its concern about the impact of Japan"s accelerating shift toward less regulated financial markets on these institutions" competitive positions as long-term credit banks.
It said its reviews would focus on the prospective value of the long-term credit bank franchise in the context of deregulation and an increasingly competitive market environment.
In addition, Moody's said, it would consider the potential impact of higher debenture funding costs on the banks" net interest margins and core profitability.
